title: Embedding polynomial-estimation sample indices
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let the failure parameter lie in $(0,1/2]$. Polynomial-estimation sample indices embed injectively into the combined restricted sample indices by adding the total number of coefficient-estimation samples across the low-degree junta Fourier family.
